-And more. 

~Max

notes.title: #3 Critical Bug Fixes, 2.4.2 Patch Notes...
notes.notes:
[h1]2.4.2 Patch Notes[/h1]

-Fixed a bug that would not allow the player to complete the game if they performed the alternate fatality in Lab B.

-Removed the Self Clean button on the cafeteria machine.

-Removed the mysterious white dots at the top CD Hall.

-Fixed a big that would cause the “Unlock” to display when hovering over the food machine monitor in the cafeteria.

-Fixed a bug that would cause the Camera to bug out if you transitioned into the “nighttime stage” from the lounge area.

-Fixed a bug that would lock the player in the AB hallway when loading the game after playing the endgame credits.

-Fixed a bug that would cause the map UI interface to be visible during the endgame scene.

-Fixed a bug that would allow the player to click on the ghost girl in Fenrir’s dream multiple times.

-Fixed a bug that would cause Fen to become invulnerable to detection when performing the alternate fatality in Lab 2.

-Fixed a bug that would cause Fen to walk on top or behind objects that he shouldn’t.

-Fixed a bug that would cause the meds to disappear after swapping them in the Med Lab.

-Fixed a bug that would allow players to prematurely collect the creature from Lab 2.

-Fixed a bug that would glitch out the garage if the exit was clicked when walking to the car.

-Various other Fixes and Performance Tweaks.

notes.title: 2.3.4 Patch Notes...
notes.notes:
[h1]2.3.4 Patch Notes[/h1]

-Added a volume controller to the main menu and alternate main menu. (in black/white, bottom left corner).

-Corrected the game description to clarify that Outpost 13 is an homage to The Thing, Alien, and X-Files. I also added a legal disclaimer at the bottom.

-Fixed a bug that would cause crew member Ash to be invisible in her bed sleeping.

-Fixed a bug that would lock the vent map system open after the morning transition.

-Finally found and fixed the Lab 2 bug that would lock you in the lab if you entered the Lab whenever the Doctor was leaving/in the process of leaving!

-The code for the Cafeteria machine is no longer a combination of the clue’s numbers, it is now the exact combination found in the clue.

-Fixed the computer interaction mechanic in Lab B.

-Fixed the chemical mixing interaction mechanic in Lab B.

-Fixed a bug in the Cafeteria that would cause a terrible audio trigger/loop when the food machine activation reached 60%.

-Fixed a bug that would cause the top exit of the outpost to appear useable at times when it is not.

-Fixed a bug that would cause the snow foot step sound to be triggered when inside the Outpost.

-Changed the text on the game over screen.

-Corrected the localization support on store front to reflect the current lack of interface localization.

[h1]Please Report Any Bugs[/h1]
I'm very interested in squashing any bugs and glitches. So if you see something that isn't right, call it out! 

If you have a recommendation, let me know in the forums! I appreciate any and all feedback. 

[h1]What's being worked on:[/h1]
-Improved localization.
-Character selection mechanic. 
-Adding a Map. 
-Polishing the puzzle mechanics in the Cafeteria.
-Revised Intro/tutorial: I plan on reworking the beginning of Day 1 and/or the tutorial to better explain the mechanics of Outpost 13, so that I can do away with the "info screen." 
-And more. 



~Max

notes.title: Release Date & Slacker Backer Deadline!
notes.notes:
[h1]When will Outpost 13 release? [/h1]
Act 1 of Outpost 13 has been scheduled to release on October 27th (2015). Act 2 is set to release sometime in the Winter. 

[b]Note:[/b] Those who supported and backed Outpost 13 via Kickstarter and Humble, will receive their copies before public release. A specific backer release date will be set once the final beta test is underway. :)

[h1]What time will it unlock on Steam?[/h1]
Midnight, specifically 12:01am EST on the 27th of October, 2015.

[h1]When does the Slacker Backer end?[/h1]
The Outpost 13 Slacker Backer will end on September 30th at 11:59pm EST. If you plan on backing, you still have a little time left.

[h1]Thank You, Stay tuned![/h1]
As always, thank you everyone for your ongoing support, interest and patience for Outpost 13!

~Max

notes.title: Patch 1.8 is Out! Internal Review Time!
notes.notes:
[h1]1.8 Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Medical Bay.
[*]Added item (used to complete medical Bay) in your inventory. 
[*]Misc performance tweaks.
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] There is no inventory view for the added "item", a "use" area button is auto-unlocked when you have it. You will need to locate this "item" in final release.


[b]Known Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*]Lab 2 collision issue with table.
[*]Fen is not always facing in the forward position.
[*]Vehicle in garage missing interaction menu after area completion.
[/list]

[h1]Internal Review[/h1]
Act 1 of Outpost 13 is now going into internal review. During this stage of development, various cut scenes and dialogue will be added. The "after hours" mechanic will also be incorporated, and each "level" will undergo a review process to add in animations, missing mechanics, and various polish. 

[b]Please note:[/b] This process is going to take several weeks to complete. Once the internal review is completed, Outpost 13 will enter Beta and go into community review in preparation for Kickstarter fulfillment.


[h1]Thank You, Stay Tuned![/h1]
As always, thank you everyone for your ongoing support, interest and patience for Outpost 13! I'll have more to announce about the internal review in the coming weeks.

~Max
